rationale: The ground truth is thin (mostly off-topic PR chatter plus one inline ask to extend reduce_scatter test verification, which the diff already appears to satisfy); X engages that exact test region more directly by proposing extending device_communicator/reduce_scatter assertions to _TP, giving it a slight recall edge there. But Y surfaces several substantive, well-grounded correctness bugs the diff actually introduces — the DP-metadata hook gated on world_size rather than on the MoE mapping being active, a plausible collective hang under CFG parallelism with an honest caveat about pre-existing brokenness, and a stale data_parallel_rank — each traced through real vLLM internals with concrete fixes, whereas X's findings are largely mechanical 'add more tests' suggestions dressed in heavy evidence-citation formatting without comparable depth. Y's higher precision and actionability outweigh its lower literal alignment with the sparse ground truth.
